visual_action: The video displays a screenshot of a tweet from an account named 'FactPost'. The tweet claims the Trump administration is closing the nation's primary bee research laboratory and shows a photo of Donald Trump next to a photo of bees on a honeycomb. The video then cuts to an image of Barry B. Benson, the main character from the animated film 'Bee Movie', with text overlaid that reads, 'this is who he's coming for btw'.
